title: Open-SWE-Traces: Advancing Dual-Mode Multilingual Distillation for Software Engineering Agents
authors_zh: Wasi Uddin Ahmad、Nikolai Ludwig、Somshubra Majumdar、Boris Ginsburg
paper_type_zh: 多语言软件工程 agent 轨迹数据发布与双模式蒸馏配方
best_for_zh: 关注 repository-level agent、SWE-bench 类环境、工具交互轨迹、失败数据利用和可执行反馈审计的研究者
one_line: Releases 207,489 multilingual software-agent episodes from 20,000 SWE-rebench-V2 pull-request tasks across two teachers and two harness families, retaining solved, unresolved, and unavailable outcomes.
发布 207,489 条多语言软件工程 agent episode，来源为 20,000 个 SWE-rebench-V2 PR 任务、两类教师模型与两类 harness，并保留已解决、未解决和结果不可用三类 outcome。
why: It makes large-scale SWE-agent distillation inspectable at episode level and provides direct evidence about the value and risks of training on non-success trajectories.
inclusion_reason: A released multilingual software-engineering trajectory corpus that preserves full tool-use episodes, patches, source-repository metadata, and solved, unresolved, and unavailable environmental outcomes for distillation and audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open-SWE-Traces addresses a data bottleneck between software-agent evaluation and training. Repository-level agents act over long episodes: they read issue text, inspect a codebase, call shell or editing tools, observe environment responses, propose a patch, and receive an executable outcome. Public corpora often expose tasks or final patches without the complete interaction history needed to distill those behaviors, and filtering to successes alone removes evidence about unproductive search and recovery.

The primary source is arXiv v1, submitted on 14 June 2026, with an official NVIDIA Hugging Face release. The released data object is a full software-engineering agent episode, not merely an issue–patch pair. It connects a SWE-rebench-V2 task and repository to a teacher-generated conversation/tool trajectory, model and reference patches, and a three-valued environmental outcome. This makes the work relevant to the atlas's data-construction and open-release track: the central contribution is a published recipe and corpus for turning executable pull-request tasks into multilingual distillation records.

The decision boundary is important. Open-SWE-Traces is not a new task benchmark, a learned reward model, or a proof that every retained trajectory is high quality. Its evaluation experiments test whether the released mixture can train software agents under the authors' setup; benchmark scores are evidence about that setup, not independent validation of every row.

Open-SWE-Traces 处理的是软件工程 agent 评测与训练之间的数据瓶颈。Repository-level agent 在长 episode 中行动：读取 issue 文本、检查代码库、调用 shell 或编辑工具、接收环境响应、提出 patch，并获得可执行 outcome。公开语料常只提供任务或最终 patch，缺少蒸馏这些行为所需的完整交互历史；只保留成功样本还会删除无效搜索与恢复过程的证据。

主要来源是 2026 年 6 月 14 日提交的 arXiv v1，并配有 NVIDIA 官方 Hugging Face 发布物。公开的数据对象是完整的软件工程 agent episode，而不只是 issue–patch 对：它把 SWE-rebench-V2 任务与代码库、教师生成的对话/工具轨迹、模型 patch、参考 patch 以及三值环境 outcome 连接起来。因此，本工作与图谱中的“数据构造与开放发布配方”方向直接相关：核心贡献是一个已发布的流程和语料，把可执行 PR 任务转化为多语言蒸馏记录。

需要明确边界。Open-SWE-Traces 不是新的任务 benchmark、学习式 reward model，也不能证明每条保留轨迹都是高质量数据。其实验只检验该数据混合在作者设定下能否训练软件工程 agent；benchmark 分数是对该设定的证据，而不是对每一行数据的独立质量验证。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a released 207,489-episode corpus built by crossing two teacher modes with two agent-harness families over 20,000 unique SWE-rebench-V2 pull-request tasks. MiniMax-M2.5 supplies explicit thinking trajectories; Qwen3.5-122B-A10B supplies non-thinking trajectories. Each teacher is used with OpenHands- and SWE-agent-family interfaces, yielding four public configurations across nine programming languages.

The data unit preserves state–action evidence rather than only a terminal answer. A record carries instance_id, repository, repository-license label, language, trajectory_id, the structured trajectory, serialized tool definitions, resolved, nested patch/category metadata, and hf_dataset_name. Conversation turns distinguish system, user, assistant, and tool roles; MiniMax records can retain reasoning_content. The feedback contract is environmental and outcome-level: repository tests label a patch solved (1), unresolved (0), or unavailable (-1). It is not stepwise correctness supervision.

The release intentionally retains non-success episodes: 65,244 are resolved, 95,487 unresolved, and 46,758 have unavailable outcome information. Relative to a resolved-only subset, this exposes failed searches, partial progress, and harness interaction patterns that can be sampled under explicit objectives. Relative to SWE-rebench-V2 itself, the novelty lies in materializing teacher–environment interaction episodes from the task substrate; the underlying pull requests, agent frameworks, and executable-test idea are reused rather than newly introduced.

该工作的核心贡献是在 20,000 个唯一 SWE-rebench-V2 PR 任务上，将两种教师模式与两类 agent harness 交叉，发布 207,489 条 episode。MiniMax-M2.5 生成显式 thinking 轨迹，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 生成 non-thinking 轨迹；两种教师分别结合 OpenHands 与 SWE-agent 系列接口，形成覆盖九种编程语言的四个公开配置。

数据单元保留 state–action 证据，而不只保留终局答案。每条记录包含 instance_id、代码库、代码库许可证标签、语言、trajectory_id、结构化 trajectory、序列化工具定义、resolved、嵌套的 patch/类别元数据和 hf_dataset_name。对话轮次区分 system、user、assistant 与 tool 角色；MiniMax 记录可保留 reasoning_content。反馈契约来自环境，并位于 outcome 级：代码库测试把 patch 标为已解决（1）、未解决（0）或结果不可用（-1），而不是逐步正确性监督。

发布物有意保留非成功 episode：65,244 条已解决、95,487 条未解决、46,758 条 outcome 不可用。相对于 resolved-only 子集，这些数据暴露失败搜索、部分进展和 harness 交互模式，可在明确目标下采样。相对于 SWE-rebench-V2 本身，新意在于从任务基底物化教师与环境的交互 episode；底层 PR、agent framework 和可执行测试思想均为复用，而非本工作首次提出。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins with SWE-rebench-V2. The authors select 20,000 unique pull-request tasks in Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Java, PHP, C, and C++, retaining repositories labeled MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, or BSD-3-Clause. MiniMax-M2.5 and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B then operate in containerized repository tasks through OpenHands and SWE-agent interfaces, exploring files, invoking tools, and iteratively producing patches.

Raw framework logs are aggregated into a common representation. Runtime validation removes environment-corrupted traces. Behavioral pruning removes maximum-iteration and premature terminations, empty patches, edits to test_patch, malformed or illegal concurrent tool interactions, and repeated tool errors. An AST-based TrajectoryScanner inspects Bash commands and rejects prohibited git-history access, including risky uses of reflog, blame, log, or diff under the scanner's context rules. The survivors are normalized into Parquet with role/content/tool-call fields and, where available, reasoning_content.

Repository tests supply the terminal outcome, but the release does not include per-row test commands, logs, checksums, or a cause code for resolved=-1. The current HF release has openhands and sweagent configurations, each with minimax_m25 and qwen35_122b splits; these four source modes total 49,948, 55,488, 57,268, and 44,785 rows. The Viewer reports ten top-level fields. reference_patch and model_patch are nested inside metadata, together with patch-size statistics; they are not top-level columns.

For validation, the paper performs SFT on Qwen3-30B-A3B Thinking, Instruct, and Coder variants. Reported SFT settings are learning rate 1e-5, batch size 32, maximum context 131,072, warmup ratio 0.1, weight decay 0.01, cosine schedule, and three epochs. Evaluation uses up to 250 turns and 256K context with separate /think and /no_think decoding settings. Teacher-generation temperature, seeds, retry policy, raw rejection counts, exact harness/container commits, optimizer name, and public-row-to-ablation manifests are unknown.

Public verification artifacts are the arXiv paper and appendix, the NVIDIA collection, the 18.3 GB Parquet dataset, and two tool-definition JSON files. At the verified date, the official collection exposes the paper and dataset but no construction code repository or OPEN-SWE-AGENT checkpoint.

构造流程从 SWE-rebench-V2 开始。作者选择 20,000 个唯一 PR 任务，语言包括 Python、Go、TypeScript、JavaScript、Rust、Java、PHP、C 和 C++，并只保留许可证标签为 MIT、Apache-2.0、BSD-2-Clause 或 BSD-3-Clause 的代码库。随后，MiniMax-M2.5 与 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 通过 OpenHands 和 SWE-agent 接口在容器化代码库任务中运行，探索文件、调用工具并迭代生成 patch。

不同 framework 的原始日志先被聚合成统一表示。运行时校验移除环境损坏的轨迹；行为剪枝移除达到最大迭代数或提前终止、空 patch、修改 test_patch、格式错误或非法并发工具交互以及重复工具错误。基于 AST 的 TrajectoryScanner 检查 Bash 命令，并按上下文规则拒绝禁止的 git 历史访问，包括高风险的 reflog、blame、log 或 diff 用法。剩余记录被标准化为 Parquet，包含 role/content/tool-call 字段，并在可用时保留 reasoning_content。

代码库测试提供终局 outcome，但发布物没有逐行测试命令、日志、checksum，也没有解释 resolved=-1 的原因码。当前 HF 发布物包含 openhands 与 sweagent 两个 configuration，每个再分为 minimax_m25 与 qwen35_122b split；四种来源模式分别有 49,948、55,488、57,268 和 44,785 行。Viewer 显示十个顶层字段。reference_patch 与 model_patch 连同 patch 大小统计嵌套在 metadata 中，并非顶层列。

作为验证，论文对 Qwen3-30B-A3B Thinking、Instruct 和 Coder 变体执行 SFT。报告的 SFT 设置为学习率 1e-5、batch size 32、最大上下文 131,072、warmup ratio 0.1、weight decay 0.01、cosine schedule 和三个 epoch。评测最多使用 250 turns 与 256K context，并为 /think 和 /no_think 分别设置解码参数。教师生成温度、随机种子、重试策略、原始淘汰数量、精确 harness/container commit、optimizer 名称，以及公开行到各 ablation 的清单均为 unknown。

可公开核验的产物包括 arXiv 论文及附录、NVIDIA collection、18.3 GB Parquet 数据集和两个工具定义 JSON 文件。在本卡核验日期，官方 collection 只公开论文与数据集，未提供构造代码仓库或 OPEN-SWE-AGENT checkpoint。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official dataset and paper agree on 207,489 trajectories over nine languages. The four mode counts sum exactly to that total. The dataset card's outcome table sums to 65,244 resolved, 95,487 unresolved, and 46,758 unknown trajectories. Therefore, 65,244/207,489 is 31.4%. The paper's approximately 40.6% pass rate is reproducible only when unknown outcomes are excluded: 65,244/(65,244+95,487) = 40.6%. This denominator distinction matters for sampling and audit.

The paper reports concrete trajectory-shape differences. In OpenHands, non-thinking and thinking modes average 94.08 and 58.22 assistant turns per trajectory; in SWE-agent they average 130.70 and 74.82. Thinking traces use more tokens per turn, so fewer turns should not be read as lower total compute or better semantic quality without further evidence.

Table 5 provides the most direct evidence for retaining non-success data in the authors' training setup. Moving from resolved-only to the full corpus changes SWE-bench Verified scores from 55.3 to 58.1 in thinking mode and 57.7 to 59.8 in non-thinking mode; SWE-bench Multilingual changes from 40.5 to 47.6 and from 49.6 to 57.1. The full dual-mode model's best reported results are 61.7% on SWE-bench Verified, 57.1% on SWE-bench Multilingual, and 36.8% on SWE-bench Pro. These are downstream ablations, not proof that unresolved or unknown rows are individually correct, safe, or non-contaminating.

Artifact evidence is stronger for availability than for replay. The HF Viewer reports 207,489 rows, 18,338,420,390 bytes of Parquet data, ten top-level fields, four completed source-mode splits, and no gated access. Revision 9c0e4579a4ee0effa3e5f7a552494a045f29377d was current when checked. However, the public schema does not expose container hashes, task commits, test logs, teacher decoding settings, or row-level rejection reasons.

官方数据集与论文一致报告九种语言、207,489 条轨迹；四种模式的数量精确相加为该总数。数据卡的 outcome 表可汇总为 65,244 条 resolved、95,487 条 unresolved 和 46,758 条 unknown。因此，65,244/207,489 为 31.4%。论文约 40.6% 的 pass rate 只有在排除 unknown 后才能复现：65,244/(65,244+95,487) = 40.6%。这一分母区别直接影响采样与审计。

论文还报告了具体轨迹形态差异。在 OpenHands 中，non-thinking 与 thinking 模式平均每条轨迹分别有 94.08 和 58.22 个 assistant turn；在 SWE-agent 中分别为 130.70 和 74.82。Thinking 轨迹每个 turn 使用更多 token，因此不能在缺少更多证据时把较少 turn 直接解释为较低总计算量或更高语义质量。

Table 5 是作者设定下保留非成功数据最直接的证据。从 resolved-only 切换到完整语料时，SWE-bench Verified 的 thinking 分数由 55.3 升至 58.1，non-thinking 由 57.7 升至 59.8；SWE-bench Multilingual 则分别由 40.5 升至 47.6、由 49.6 升至 57.1。完整双模式模型报告的最佳结果为 SWE-bench Verified 61.7%、SWE-bench Multilingual 57.1%、SWE-bench Pro 36.8%。这些是下游 ablation，不能证明每条 unresolved 或 unknown 记录都正确、安全或没有污染风险。

公开产物对“可获得性”的证明强于对“可重放性”的证明。HF Viewer 报告 207,489 行、18,338,420,390 bytes Parquet、十个顶层字段、四个已完成的来源模式 split，且无需 gated access；核验时当前 revision 为 9c0e4579a4ee0effa3e5f7a552494a045f29377d。但公开 schema 不包含 container hash、任务 commit、测试日志、教师解码设置或逐行淘汰原因。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Open-SWE-Traces combines four properties in one public episode schema: 207,489 trajectories, nine programming languages, two agent-harness families, and paired thinking/non-thinking teacher modes. The schema retains conversation roles, tools, model and reference patches, source-repository metadata, and a three-valued outcome, so users can inspect both the action process and terminal result.

Its most consequential design choice is to release unresolved and unavailable-outcome episodes instead of restricting the corpus to successful demonstrations. The paper then ablates resolved-only versus full-data training, creating a direct connection between a curation choice and downstream behavior. The integrity pipeline also targets agent-specific shortcuts—test editing and git-history inspection—rather than applying only generic text deduplication.

What is not new should remain visible. SWE-rebench-V2 provides the executable task substrate; OpenHands and SWE-agent provide the interaction frameworks; MiniMax-M2.5 and Qwen3.5 provide teacher behavior; repository tests provide outcome verification. The paper's contribution is their multilingual, dual-mode synthesis, filtering, normalization, release, and distillation study. Scale and benchmark performance alone do not establish higher data quality than prior software-agent corpora.

Open-SWE-Traces 在一个公开 episode schema 中结合四项特征：207,489 条轨迹、九种编程语言、两类 agent harness，以及 thinking/non-thinking 双教师模式。Schema 保留对话角色、工具、模型 patch、参考 patch、源代码库元数据和三值 outcome，使复用者可以同时检查行动过程与终局结果。

最关键的设计选择是发布 unresolved 和 outcome 不可用的 episode，而非只保留成功示范。论文进一步比较 resolved-only 与完整数据训练，把一个 curation 决策直接连接到下游行为。完整性流程还针对 agent 特有捷径——修改测试和查看 git 历史——而不只是执行通用文本去重。

同时要保留“哪些部分并非新贡献”。SWE-rebench-V2 提供可执行任务基底，OpenHands 和 SWE-agent 提供交互 framework，MiniMax-M2.5 与 Qwen3.5 提供教师行为，代码库测试提供 outcome 验证。论文的贡献是对这些组件进行多语言、双模式合成、过滤、标准化、发布与蒸馏研究。规模和 benchmark 表现本身不能证明其数据质量必然高于既有软件 agent 语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Outcome semantics are coarse. resolved=0 says that the patch did not resolve the task under the harness, while -1 says outcome information is unavailable; neither identifies whether failure came from reasoning, tools, tests, infrastructure, or missing evaluation. Unit tests can be incomplete or flaky, and the release omits per-row test logs and commands. The 40.6% pass rate also excludes unknown outcomes and should not be quoted as a fraction of all 207,489 rows.

Exact replay is under-specified. Rows expose instance_id, repository, source-dataset name, trajectory, tools, and patches, but not explicit canonical PR URLs, base/head commit SHAs, container digests, harness versions, seeds, teacher decoding, retries, or rejection reasons. The official collection currently lacks pipeline code and an OPEN-SWE-AGENT checkpoint. The paper also reports framework overfitting and 5-10% looping behavior for the evaluated model in MOpenHands.

Release rights and privacy need independent review. The dataset card applies CC BY 4.0 and source repositories are filtered by permissive repository-license labels, but that does not separately establish rights for issue/PR prose, patch fragments, dependencies, teacher outputs, or retained reasoning. The ethics statement says automated filters redact PII and credentials, yet no detector specification or residual-risk measurement is provided. Long tool logs and explicit reasoning can still carry secrets, personal data, insecure commands, or teacher-specific vulnerabilities.

No broad decontamination analysis is reported between the 20,000 source tasks and SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, or Pro. TrajectoryScanner addresses git-history shortcuts inside a run, not train–evaluation overlap. Because the public configurations are source modes rather than held-out splits, reusers must construct their own leakage-resistant partitions before evaluation.

Outcome 语义较粗。resolved=0 表示 patch 在 harness 下未解决任务，-1 表示 outcome 信息不可用；二者都无法说明问题来自推理、工具、测试、基础设施还是缺失评测。单元测试可能不完整或不稳定，发布物又未提供逐行测试日志与命令。40.6% pass rate 还排除了 unknown，不能写成全部 207,489 行中的比例。

精确重放信息不足。记录公开 instance_id、代码库、源数据集名、轨迹、工具和 patch，但没有显式规范 PR URL、base/head commit SHA、container digest、harness 版本、随机种子、教师解码参数、重试信息或淘汰原因。官方 collection 目前也没有 pipeline code 和 OPEN-SWE-AGENT checkpoint。论文还报告了 framework 过拟合，以及被评测模型在 MOpenHands 中 5–10% 的循环行为。

发布权利与隐私需要独立审计。数据卡对发布物使用 CC BY 4.0，源代码库按宽松的 repository-license 标签过滤，但这并不能分别确立 issue/PR 文本、patch 片段、依赖、教师输出或保留 reasoning 的权利。Ethics Statement 称自动过滤器会清除 PII 与 credential，却未公开检测器细节或残余风险测量。长工具日志与显式 reasoning 仍可能携带秘密、个人数据、不安全命令或教师特有漏洞。

论文没有报告 20,000 个源任务与 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 或 Pro 之间的广泛去污染分析。TrajectoryScanner 处理的是单次运行中的 git-history 捷径，不是训练–评测重叠。公开 configuration 是来源模式，而非 held-out split；复用者必须自行构建抗泄漏划分后再评测。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction and open-release track, this work is a concrete recipe for converting executable repository tasks into auditable distillation episodes. It identifies the source-task filter, teacher modes, agent interfaces, structural and behavioral pruning, git-integrity scan, normalized schema, outcome contract, public shard organization, and student-training settings. That makes it useful as a design reference even when exact replay remains incomplete.

The corpus can support supervised fine-tuning, thinking/non-thinking distillation, tool-call modeling, failure-aware curricula, outcome-conditioned sampling, and studies of transfer between OpenHands- and SWE-agent-style interfaces. Patches and terminal labels permit analyses of where reasoning, tool use, and code changes diverge. Unresolved traces may be useful as negative or exploratory data, but only under an explicit objective; resolved=-1 should be isolated from confirmed failures.

Responsible reuse should pin the HF revision and shard hashes, recover canonical PR and commit lineage, retain repository/license/patch fields, snapshot harnesses and containers, and construct leakage-resistant train/evaluation splits. Test quality and outcome causes should be audited before using resolved as a reward. The release is directly suited to SFT and distillation; it is not automatically an online-RL environment or a step-level process-supervision dataset because reset/replay artifacts and per-action correctness labels are not included.

对“数据构造与开放发布配方”方向而言，本工作给出一个把可执行代码库任务转化为可审计蒸馏 episode 的具体流程。它说明源任务过滤、教师模式、agent 接口、结构与行为剪枝、git 完整性扫描、统一 schema、outcome 契约、公开 shard 组织和学生训练设置。即使精确重放仍不完整，它也可作为数据设计参考。

该语料可用于 SFT、thinking/non-thinking 蒸馏、工具调用建模、失败感知 curriculum、按 outcome 采样，以及 OpenHands 与 SWE-agent 风格接口之间的迁移研究。Patch 与终局标签支持分析 reasoning、工具使用和代码修改在何处发生分离。Unresolved 轨迹可在明确目标下作为负样本或探索数据，但 resolved=-1 应与确认失败隔离。

负责任复用应固定 HF revision 与 shard hash，恢复规范 PR 和 commit lineage，保留代码库/许可证/patch 字段，快照 harness 与 container，并构建抗泄漏的训练–评测划分。在把 resolved 当作 reward 前，需要审计测试质量和 outcome 原因。该发布物直接适合 SFT 与蒸馏；由于没有 reset/replay 产物和逐行动正确性标签，它不会自动成为 online-RL environment 或 step-level process-supervision 数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep four denominators separate: 20,000 unique PR tasks, 207,489 released trajectories, 160,731 known outcomes, and 65,244 resolved trajectories.
  • Read resolved exactly as documented: 1 solved, 0 unresolved, and -1 unavailable; the reported 40.6% excludes -1.
  • Compare thinking/non-thinking teachers and OpenHands/SWE-agent configurations as four source modes, not train/validation/test splits.
  • Inspect runtime, patch, tool-schema, test-editing, and git-history filters, then note that their code and rejection ledger are not public.
  • Pin HF revision 9c0e4579a4ee0effa3e5f7a552494a045f29377d or a later audited revision and recover PR/commit/container lineage before replay or evaluation.

• 区分四个分母：20,000 个唯一 PR 任务、207,489 条公开轨迹、160,731 条已知 outcome，以及 65,244 条 resolved 轨迹。
  • 严格按数据卡解释 resolved：1 为已解决、0 为未解决、-1 为不可用；报告的 40.6% 排除了 -1。
  • 把 thinking/non-thinking 教师与 OpenHands/SWE-agent configuration 看作四种来源模式，而不是 train/validation/test split。
  • 检查运行时、patch、工具 schema、修改测试和 git-history 过滤，同时注意其代码与淘汰台账没有公开。
  • 重放或评测前固定 HF revision 9c0e4579a4ee0effa3e5f7a552494a045f29377d 或更新的已审计 revision，并恢复 PR/commit/container lineage。

value.html: 20,000 unique real-world pull-request tasks selected from SWE-rebench-V2 after language and repository-license filtering.

One repository-level episode with instance and trajectory identifiers, repository/license/language fields, a structured conversation and tool history, a three-valued resolved label, and category/reference-patch/model-patch metadata.
MiniMax-M2.5 generates thinking trajectories and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B generates non-thinking trajectories through OpenHands- and SWE-agent-family harnesses.
Containerized SWE-rebench-V2 repository tasks executed with OpenHands and SWE-agent; the paper uses the multilingual MOpenHands and MSWE-agent variants for training/evaluation experiments.

Repository tests provide an environmental outcome: resolved=1 for solved, resolved=0 for unresolved, and resolved=-1 when outcome information is unavailable. Exact per-row test commands and logs are not released.

The harness completes an episode and evaluates its patch against task tests; incomplete, prematurely terminated, empty-patch, test-editing, malformed-tool, repeated-error, or prohibited git-history trajectories are removed before release.
The teachers are MiniMax-M2.5 and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B; the validation students are Qwen3-30B-A3B Thinking, Instruct, and Coder variants.
MiniMax-M2.5 for thinking traces and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B for non-thinking traces.
OpenHands and SWE-agent agent-computer interfaces over SWE-rebench-V2 containers; exact generation-harness revisions are unknown.

For each selected task, run teacher/harness combinations, aggregate heterogeneous logs, validate runtime completion, apply behavioral and git-integrity filters, then normalize surviving episodes into a shared Parquet schema.
207,489 retained trajectories; raw generation volume, retry count, and rejected-count breakdown are unknown.
unknown

Restrict to nine languages and repositories labeled MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, or BSD-3-Clause; remove runtime-corrupted or incomplete episodes, empty patches, test edits, malformed or illegal concurrent tool calls, repeated tool errors, and AST-detected prohibited git-history inspection.
Generation turn/token budgets are unknown. Student evaluation uses maximum 250 turns and a 256K context; /think and /no_think decoding settings are reported only for evaluation.

Agent scaffolds are OpenHands and SWE-agent. Student SFT uses learning rate 1e-5, batch size 32, 131,072-token context, 0.1 warmup ratio, cosine schedule, and three epochs; the optimizer name is unknown.
20,000 unique pull-request tasks from SWE-rebench-V2 repositories in Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Java, PHP, C, and C++, restricted by four permissive repository-license labels.
The release has openhands and sweagent configurations, each split by minimax_m25 and qwen35_122b. These are source modes, not conventional train/validation/test partitions.
TrajectoryScanner removes prohibited git-history inspection, but no broader overlap audit against SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, or Pro is disclosed.

items: Only 65,244 of 207,489 trajectories are resolved; 95,487 are unresolved and 46,758 have unavailable outcome information.
The reported 40.6% pass rate uses the 160,731 known outcomes as denominator, not all released trajectories.
An unresolved or unknown episode can contain useful partial work, misleading behavior, flaky-test effects, or environment failures that public fields cannot disambiguate.
Harness-specific action and observation formats cause transfer loss; the paper reports MOpenHands loops in 5-10% of evaluated cases for OPEN-SWE-AGENT.
Repository-level license labels do not by themselves establish rights for every component carried into a trace.
The paper reports automated PII and credential redaction but does not disclose the detector, recall study, or residual-risk audit.
